name: Lae'zel
lead: Lae'zel of Crèche K'liir is an Origin Character and a recruitable Companion who can be romanced by characters of any gender. She is a Githyanki Fighter with the Soldier background. Unless played as an origin character, Lae'zel is first encountered on the Nautiloid during the prologue, where she serves as a temporary companion, and can be properly recruited on the Roadside Cliffs in Act One .
A ferocious warrior zealously devoted to the Lich Queen Vlaakith , Lae'zel will do whatever is necessary to end the terror of the Illithid and prove herself to her queen.
